body:
I recieved a handful Robaxin pills from a friend who didnt want or like muscle relaxers. I am no stranger to poppin pills so I was excited for whatever was in store for me. These 750mg Robaxin pills were the same size and color of 750mg vicodin so I decided not to snort them, instead I made sure I ate beforehand to decrease the chance of nausea. When I have flexeril I usually just snort a couple of the small pills and within minutes I am feelin it.
00:00 Swallowed 4 x 750mg and surfed the web waiting for the effects to kick in.
01:00 An hour has past and I felt little to nothing at all, not even bad side-effects. I proceeded to take 3 more at this time.
01:45 Starting to feel a little more relaxed and a little less coordinated but nuthing special. I decide to take 1mg of Xanax because this was not giving me the relaxation I desired
.
02:00 Almost instantly feeling the Xanax and feeling better (in a relaxed way). I Loove Xanax :)
Robaxin is a very week drug, probably good for medical use but it doesn't give a good high. Xanax on the other hand is a very powerful and cheap drug and the best pill out there for me.  I just try to stay away from my bed or something like that because if I lay down its lites out for me.
